Name: CS_KEY_ASSIGN_MENUITEM_PARAM
Description: Entries of the key configuration menu, in row order, and of the controls overview. A row with a Key is a rebindable action; a row without one is a category heading.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: With a Key: the entry name and its one-line help text. Without a Key: the category name. Not set: the entry is left out of the pad and key configuration lists and only appears in the controls overview.

Fields.Name: Key
Fields.Description: The user input key this entry rebinds. Not set: the entry is a category heading.

Fields.Name: Allow Unassignment
Fields.Description: If ON, then this key can be unassigned.

Fields.Name: Allow Pad Configuration
Fields.Description: If ON, the controller binding of this entry can be changed.

Fields.Name: Allow Mouse Configuration
Fields.Description: If ON, the mouse binding of this entry can be changed.

Fields.Name: Conflict Group
Fields.Description: Group used to detect duplicate bindings: entries in the same group can't share an input.

Fields.Name: Controls Overview Text ID
Fields.Description: Name of the action shown in the controls overview. 0: not shown in the overview.
